Nina P: Hi all - finished HR but no HubSpot/Gong yet. Getting a 401 on HubSpot. Anyone to ping?

Hannah (Sales Ops): Welcome @Nina! Send emp id and we'll queue your seat. HubSpot usually in 20-30m, Gong from enablement.

Nina P: emp id RWF-2455, nina.p@redwood.ai

buddy-bot: Welcome Nina! Your Sales buddy is Riya. Intro meeting scheduled.

Luis (IT): I see a failed auth. Pushed a temporary HubSpot invite and flagged SAML mapping. Try the invite link in ~5m.

Nina P: Got the invite and it worked - HubSpot loading now. Thanks Luis!

Riya (Enablement): Awesome. Two quick things: 1) Dialpad auto-provisions but you may need to install the app, 2) Gong invite will arrive from enablement@redwood.ai - accept and tag recordings with #coaching for enablement review.

Nina P: Installer downloads fine but Dialpad shows "no number assigned". Who handles numbers?

Luis (IT): Telecom assigns numbers. I'll request placement in shared pool unless you want a dedicated DID (file TELE-77).

Hannah (Sales Ops): Checklist for Nina: [x] HR done, [x] HubSpot access, [ ] Dialpad number, [ ] Gong invite. Ping here if anything stalls.

Nina P: Thanks everyone - I'll wait on the Gong invite and will join the buddy session.

Riya (Enablement): Welcome aboard! Quick 30s intro script: "Hi, I'm Nina from Redwood Inference. We help teams cut serving latency and cost for LLMs. Who owns model serving where you are?"

(END OF THREAD)
